text:
alex: Quick API-contract Q: I want to change /rerank response to include a score_unit and a deterministic_sort_key. proposal below. keeping old fields for one release. thoughts?

maria: quick context? why score_unit?

alex: raw_score currently varies by model (logit-scale). customers expect stable 0-1 sometimes. adding score_unit to indicate whether score is "raw" or "prob" or "normalized_0_1". no runtime conversion unless requested.

kevin: sounds reasonable. in terms of compatibility, do we rename raw_score or keep both?

alex: plan: keep raw_score (unchanged), add score (normalized when available), score_unit string, and deterministic_sort_key for stable ordering when scores tie. mark score as optional. older clients keep reading raw_score. new clients prefer score+score_unit.

sasha: can you paste minimal response example?

alex: sure:
```json
{
  "items": [
    {
      "id": "doc_123",
      "raw_score": -2.345,
      "score": 0.83,
      "score_unit": "normalized_0_1",
      "deterministic_sort_key": "sha256:5e2f..."
    }
  ],
  "model": "redwood-re-rank-v2",
  "meta": {"score_convention": "raw:logit; score:0-1 normalized using sigmoid+calibration"}
}
```

maria: ok. small nit: deterministic_sort_key needs to be stable across reranks and across replica seeds. how do we derive it?

alex: idea: deterministic_sort_key = hex(hmac(secretless, concat(id, stable_features))) where stable_features are item id + original_index + maybe publishing_ts. no secrets, purely deterministic.

kevin: maybe include original_index as fallback. workers must compute same value independent of hardware. please add spec: stringify fields in canonical order before hashing.

sasha: also callout that if score is absent (model can't normalize) clients should fallback to stable sort by deterministic_sort_key, then by raw_score descending. we should spell that out.

alex: agreed. fallback ordering: 1) if score present, sort by score desc; 2) tie-breaker: deterministic_sort_key asc; 3) final tie: raw_score desc; 4) final: original_index asc.

ci-bot: deploy-checklist: remember to add schema migration tests and a flag for turning normalization on per-model. :white_check_mark:

maria: do we need a version bump in response? e.g., response_schema_version = "1.1"

alex: yes, adding response_schema_version at top-level. default to "1.1" for this change and document deprecation timeline for raw_score-only clients.

kevin: compatibility note for SDKs: they should keep reading raw_score until deprecation window ends. add example in changelog.

sasha: also mention latency: adding normalization step could add ~1-3ms if we do sigmoid+lookup table; recommend enabling offline calibrated tables per model to avoid per-request calibration when possible.

alex: thanks. next steps: i'll draft the API PR with schema + changelog + migration tests. tagging owners: @maria @kevin. planning to cut a small feature flag so private clusters can opt-in.

maria: lgtm. ping when PR is up.

kevin: thanks — will review.

alex: PR opened: https://redwood/repo/pull/1428 (WIP). feedback welcome.

sasha: quick ask — add a sample cURL showing both old and new fields for users to test.

alex: done in PR.

ci-bot: auto: unit-tests: 45 passed, 2 skipped on staging.

alex: will merge after kevin review and a quick perf run. :rocket:
